summary: Flat bend at the street's turn; homes about 20-23 m away.
reasons: Little parking, a van would show

best_section.where: West kerb at the bend where Woodstock Avenue turns into Manchester Terrace

drivers.seclusion: Bush and a bank on the bend's outer edge; houses 20-23 m away, an apartment block 7 m back near the start.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed bend with kerb room for a van; one car parked up the street.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; light through traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted; little kerbside parking here.

flags: Steep at the start: about 7% mean, 20% max, but flat from 14 m
Apartment building 7 m from the first 15 m of the kerb
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the south and west of the bend; open to the morning sun from the east.
